correctness.rationale: The frozen Shrikhande graph is the 16-vertex Cayley graph on Z4² with generators ±(1,0), ±(0,1), ±(1,1), giving 32 triangles. Independent full enumeration of all 65535 nonempty masks reproduced exactly 8950 triangle-free faces and f=(16,120,528,1452,2496,2568,1424,330,16). Independent lexicographic face-pair reconstruction gives 4465 matched pairs, 1 critical 0-cell, 5 critical 5-cells and 14 critical 6-cells, and the directed full Hasse matching is acyclic (8950 nodes, 48272 incidences). Signed gradient-path recursion independently reproduced the complete integral 5×14 Morse differential from certificate.json, including a determinant +1 minor on columns (0,1,4,9,11). Because the Morse CW five-skeleton is a wedge of five 5-spheres, the degree-five attaching maps are classified by π5=Z^5; unimodular cancellation leaves exactly nine 6-spheres. Raw mod-two ranks are only corroboration and alone would not certify integral homotopy.
residual_risks: Finite diagnostics alone cannot prove the universal aspects; the cited arguments supply those steps.
